title: Doctoralia México CS — AI & Transformation Manager business case

brief.problem: Two working deliverables on one dataset for a take-home + 60-minute live session: a copilot for a farming CS specialist and an automated manager report. Judged on whether it runs, whether the AI's failure modes are designed for, and whether the thinking about the data holds up under questioning.
brief.currentState: Onboarding grade is a proxy for one setup step; campaign 4 scores conversions that make doctors worse off; escalation conversion varies 31-51% by specialist purely on queue latency; ~6% of escalations have no owner.
brief.desiredState: Two connected products that run from one data layer, plus a defensible account of what the data says and where AI is allowed to be wrong.

successMetric.name: Session outcome
successMetric.target: Both products run, survive a live change request, and the three findings hold under challenge

constraints: Must run live and be editable in front of the panel in 10 minutes
Two connected things beat two polished disconnected ones
No real data from anywhere else
Must state AI tools used and what was corrected
risks: Demo fails on the panel's machine — mitigated by zero-API-key default path
A live change request lands somewhere the code is not navigable — mitigated by RULES and PLAYS as single edit points

phases.name: Read the data
phases.objective: Find what cannot be explained as presented
phases.gate: Every claim recomputable by one command

phases.name: Shared data layer
phases.objective: One place any number can come from

phases.name: Copilot
phases.objective: A draft a specialist would actually send, and a defined behaviour when unsure
phases.gate: Runs with no API key; refuses to draft below 0.55 confidence

phases.name: Manager report
phases.objective: Something a manager acts on Monday with their own people
phases.gate: Explains a movement or says it cannot; no rate below n=10

phases.name: Session rehearsal
phases.objective: Survive Part A, B and C questions and one live change
phases.gate: A live change to PLAYS or RULES lands in under 10 minutes

decisions.question: Trust the model's reading of the tables, or recompute everything?

options.label: Recompute in code
options.buys: Every claim falsifiable in one command

options.label: Trust the model
options.costs: A wrong number in front of the panel

decisions.rationale: Two of the model's first figures were wrong. src/analysis.py is the guard.

decisions.question: How do the two deliverables share data?
decisions.rationale: The brief explicitly rewards a shared data layer.

decisions.question: Does the model generate the draft, or only rewrite it?

options.label: Template composes, model polishes tone
options.buys: The model can never state a false fact; runs with no API key

options.label: Model generates from the record
options.costs: Hallucinated account facts, and a demo that dies without a key

decisions.rationale: The panel cares most about behaviour when the system is not confident. A model that cannot supply a fact cannot invent one.

decisions.question: What does confidence mean?

options.label: Evidence completeness
options.buys: Inspectable, explains itself in the specialist's terms

decisions.rationale: A specialist can act on 'no complete booking month yet'. They cannot act on 0.71.

decisions.question: Which metrics go on the manager report?
decisions.rationale: Within the 30-minute bucket every specialist converts 50-59%. The leaderboard measures the queue.

runLog.did: Full data pass; three findings plus seven data-quality flags
runLog.learned: The three headline anomalies in the pack are all the same failure: a proxy metric standing in for an outcome.

runLog.did: Pipeline with RULES dict and automatic quality checks
Copilot with 5 plays, evidence-completeness confidence, optional LLM polish
runLog.learned: 45% of a portfolio has no signal. Saying 'leave it alone' is an output.

runLog.did: Per-team HTML report with mix/rate/residual decomposition and n>=10 rate suppression
runLog.learned: First version attributed 130% of a movement. Decompositions need a residual and a publish band.
